hypothesis.statement: On a real eyes-closed posterior EEG channel (eegmmidb S002R02, POz), the newly-authored petrosianFD reproduces antropy.petrosian_fd BIT-FOR-BIT, and the value is a valid fractal dimension slightly above 1.

analysis_plan.dataset: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb, PhysioNet), subject S002, baseline run R02 (eyes-closed), channel POz (posterior), first 10 s at 160 Hz (1600 samples)

decision.threshold: descriptive: petrosianFD equals antropy.petrosian_fd to machine precision (max |diff| < 1e-9)
